warning.titlePre: Land Rover Velar D200 Ingenium Diesel Timing Chain Wear
paragraphs: If your Velar D200 is a 2017–present model with the Ingenium AJ200D 2.0-litre diesel — that's the L560 generation — timing chain tensioner wear is a well-documented pattern on this engine family, backed by established Land Rover specialist consensus. We replace worn timing chains, injector seals, EGR components and gaskets as standard on every AJ200D rebuild.
